metadata.title: Generalized Kahler BHE threefolds
metadata.abstract: We study the notion of generalized Kahler Bismut--Hermitian--Einstein (GKBHE) manifolds, namely generalized Kähler manifolds for which both Bismut Ricci forms vanish, and we develop a theory for such structures on compact threefolds. We organize the analysis according to the horizontal rank, an invariant taking values in $\{0,1,2\}$ that measures the relative position of the canonical foliations associated with the two Hermitian structures. We characterize the case of horizontal rank $0$ (which corresponds to Kähler Ricci flat geometry) and describe the case of horizontal rank $1$, revealing its close interplay with the steady $\nu$-soliton equation in Kähler geometry. This description also provides a tool for constructing new compact GKBHE threefolds.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究紧复三维流形上的广义 Kähler Bismut–Hermitian–Einstein 结构，以水平秩组织其典范叶状结构。
techniques: 双 Bismut Ricci 形式消失
水平秩与典范叶状结构
analysis.breakthrough: 刻画水平秩零的 Ricci 平坦 Kähler 情形，并描述秩一与 Kähler 稳态 ν-孤立子的联系，给出新紧例子的构造工具。
analysis.limitations: 水平秩可取 0、1、2；摘要仅宣称刻画零与描述一，不能据此宣称完成所有秩的分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
